datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Chad to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data for different scenarios. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for each month of 2021, representing projected acute food insecurity conditions.
